description: Anvil stump: a sawn section of oak trunk 0.5 m tall, ~0.58 m across the top flaring to ~0.7 m at the foot; deeply furrowed bark, one iron band below the top, sawn end-grain top with growth rings, radial checks, scorch marks and flakes of forge scale. Takes a ~0.3 m anvil on top (face at ~0.8 m).

paint.prompt: a sawn oak log: deeply furrowed grey-brown bark with cracks and lichen-free dry plates, a rusty iron band, the sawn top showing growth rings, radial cracks, black scorch marks and flakes of iron scale
